mechanism: Perphenazine may impair glucose metabolism and antagonize the glycemic effects of dapagliflozin, while dapagliflozin increases euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis risk in susceptible patients on antipsychotics.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely; perphenazine may worsen glycemic control and increase DKA risk with SGLT2 inhibitors; consider alternative antipsychotic if possible.
